searchText: oh really, I remember downloading some blobs via the API from the `devnet-1` teku supernode and was surprised that it already works lol if we store all columns, we should be able to convert them into blobs without reconstructing, because both blobs and columns are made up of `Cell`s and we just need to transform them to the right shape? Getting 50% of columns for a block every slot is not that bad *I think* - we send way more requests when doing a head sync. It may just be reaching out to a subset of peers and ask for a few columns each (potentially 1 request per peer we make request to if we batch multiple columns in one request) yep either 50% custody or if they care about bandwidth (gossip uses more) and not too sensitive to delays in getting blobs, they can still run a full node and request from peers maybe because we proposed it, I need to check, I could left old code on production right, when we have exactly first 50% (at least) but there is no such option for extended custody to get exactly first 50%, so you are either 100% or doesn't have full data probably oh yeah i thought you were talking about supernodes not being able to serve blob data over API currently we don't support this in Teku but should be easy to implement, yeah
